title: LIMBO: Lifelong Inference-Time Memory and Budget Optimization for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.14138v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As LLM agents become integrated into increasingly complex workflows, they must continually acquire new capabilities while retaining competence on previously learned tasks. Lifelong agents address this through experience replay, injecting past interactions into the prompt to leverage prior experience during inference. However, replay is not free: every replayed trajectory competes with retrieval, reasoning, tool use, and verification for the same limited prompt and compute budget, making effective resource allocation essential. Existing approaches allocate these resources using fixed replay policies, regardless of whether replay is beneficial for the current task. We identify this as inference-time memory allocation, a distinct problem class for lifelong agents, and introduce LIMBO: the first online framework to our knowledge that treats memory as a controllable inference-time resource and jointly optimizes memory strategy and inference

translated_title: LIMBO：面向LLM智能体的终身推理时记忆与预算优化
translated_abstract: 随着LLM智能体被整合到日益复杂的工作流程中，它们必须在持续获取新能力的同时，保持对先前学习任务的胜任能力。终身智能体通过经验回放来解决这一问题，即将过去的交互注入提示中以在推理时利用先前经验。然而，回放并非没有代价：每条被回放的轨迹都会与检索、推理、工具使用和验证争夺相同有限的提示和计算预算，这使得有效的资源分配至关重要。现有方法使用固定的回放策略来分配这些资源，而不考虑回放是否对当前任务有益。我们将此识别为推理时记忆分配——终身智能体面临的一类独特问题，并引入了LIMBO：据我们所知，这是首个将记忆视为可控制的推理时资源，并联合优化记忆策略与推理的在线框架。
tldr: LIMBO是首个将记忆作为可控推理时资源的在线框架，能够联合优化记忆策略与推理预算分配，从而提升LLM终身智能体的性能。
en_tdlr: LIMBO is the first online framework that treats memory as a controllable inference-time resource, jointly optimizing memory strategy and inference budget allocation to enhance lifelong LLM agents.
